newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN SAYS H1 BOOSTED BY CAP GAINS.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN SAYS H1 BOOSTED BY CAP GAINS.

text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman said on Tuesday its operating profit for the first half of the year had received a 492 million crown boost from capital gains on property and shares.

"The operating profit after depreciation came in at 1.28 billion crowns...the operating profit incorporated capital gains from property sales of 480 million crowns and from company and share sales of 12 million crowns," AssiDoman said in its six-month interim report.
The company posted a profit after financial items of 1.23 billion crowns for the first half of the year, down by 48 percent on the 2.45 billion crowns posted for the same 1995 period.
This was below market expectations of a profit after financial items of 1.27 billion crowns for the first half.
